Binance offers a good set of tools for analysing cryptocurrencies and planning trades. The liquidity details, order history, and customisable chart indicators are particularly useful. Performance is generally smooth, and the trading fees are reasonable. My main concern is the market news section, which sometimes mixes too many unrelated updates and makes it difficult to find relevant information. Better organisation and filtering options would be a welcome improvement.

Binance is pretty decent for checking how different crypto sectors are performing. I like browsing market categories, comparing token performance and spotting unusual trading volume. The app usually loads quick and there's plenty of data to explore. But some market rankings feels a bit messy, and smaller projects don't always have enough information. Wish the research tools were more detailed. Overall, quite useful for exploring crypto trends.

Something I appreciate about Binance is the flexibility when managing open trades. The partial order fills, different order types and position details are pretty handy during volatile markets. Fees ain't too bad either. My only complaint is that order notifications can be confusing sometimes, especially when several trades happen together. The interface could use better organization. Still, it's a capable platform with lots of tools for regular traders.
